facts.fact: UNDP Malawi reports that the National Registration Bureau Strategic Plan 2025-2030 was launched in Lilongwe on 4 September 2025, with universal civil registration among its six priority areas and the aim of a fully digitalised Bureau in which every birth, marriage and death is recorded.

UNDP Malawi reports the Minister of Homeland Security saying at the launch on 4 September 2025 that the National Registration Bureau's mandate is to build and maintain a comprehensive National Registration and Identification System, the Bureau's plan covering the recording of every birth, marriage and death.

systems.system: NRB database integration with the Malawi Revenue Authority and the Immigration Department

note: The release says nothing on how or where a birth or death is entered, on events registered digitally or on offices; the two facts are governance only.
